prayerExcerpt.en-US: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Combati o bom combate, terminei a corrida, guardei a fé.

meta.face: A man around 55 with a noble, kindly face: bald on top with a high receding hairline and dark wavy hair at the sides, a long dark pointed beard reaching well below the chin, a straight fine nose, calm luminous eyes with a look of fervent, gentle conviction.
meta.basis: Bald crown / receding hairline and a long pointed beard, all but mandatory from the 4th century; the Acts of Paul and Thecla call him bald.

sources.title: Christ between Peter and Paul, 4th-c. catacomb painting

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
First edit took the Acts' meeting eyebrows and hooked nose literally and came out harsh; redone idealised, keeping only the bald crown and pointed beard
